intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing VPU buffer size function pointer to SM8750 platform data to enable proper buffer allocation for this hardware variant.
intent_record.what: Added a new struct field assignment `.get_vpu_buffer_size = iris_vpu33_buf_size,` to the `sm8750_data` platform data structure initialization.
intent_record.how: This change registers the `iris_vpu33_buf_size` function as the VPU buffer size getter for the SM8750 platform. At runtime, when the driver needs to determine VPU buffer sizes for this platform, it will now call this specific function instead of using a default or missing implementation.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing max_core_mbps performance specification to SM8750 platform data to correctly define codec throughput capabilities.
intent_record.what: Added a new field `.max_core_mbps` to the `sm8750_data` structure initialization with a calculated value of `((7680 * 4320) / 256) * 60`, which evaluates to 3916800.
intent_record.how: This change adds a platform capability parameter that specifies the maximum megabits per second throughput for the SM8750 video codec hardware. The calculation represents 4K resolution (7680x4320) pixels processed at 60 fps with a 256-bit processing unit, defining the peak performance specification for this platform variant.
